headline: Reduced rent approved for Marine Trade Center through end of May during sewer project.
summary: The sewer separation project in the front parking lot is now expected to run through May. The rent reduction covers lost parking at the Marine Trade Center, and Public Works will reimburse the authority instead of signing a direct contract with the tenant. The meeting then went into executive session to discuss personnel and a vessel services request.
decisions: Approved a reduced rent for the Marine Trade Center through the end of May, unanimously.
discussion: Marine Trade Center rent reduction: Members said the authority gives vessel services and the Marine Trade Center below-market rent, and that the tenant has been a good one. Members asked about the tenant's parking and occupancy while the project is underway.
Fish exchange manager search: Two board members and city staff will draft a job description and posting. Existing staff may apply, but they must go through the same process as other applicants.

Fish exchange website plan: The authority will move to Squarespace, with a two to three week beta test after the developer gets the green light. A figure of about $5,000 was given, and members asked whether it is a yearly cost.
Fish exchange boat list: Members want a list of boats landing in Portland and boats that have left for Gloucester, shared with the board on a regular basis.

decision_evidence.quote: I would make a motion to approve the rent reduction for the duration of the project. ... Motion carries.

decision_titles: Rent reduction for Marine Trade Center through end of May
